The velocity of a particle is (5i−3j)m/s when t=0s. If the particle moves with a constant acceleration of (i+2j)m/s2, find the velocity of the particle when t=2s.

a
(10i−6j)m/s
b
(6i+j)m/s
c
(6i−j)m/s
d
(7i+j)m/s
e
(7i−j)m/s
